subject: Evidence provenance and processor chain: onboarding constraints for Medigen
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medigen.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <privacy@medigen.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: evidence provenance + subprocessor chain for EU/UK processing

Hi Hannah / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we move toward production we'll need a short, concrete package describing:

- Full subprocessor chain for services touching EU/UK personal data (including cloud providers, edge cache nodes, observability vendors).
- The provenance/evidence we can provide for each processor (attestations, SOC/SR reports, sanitized audit extracts, retention/egress logs).
- How Redwood expects to meet TIA/DTIA evidence requests and where the UK IDTA addendum fits.

Two specific constraints from our legal/procurement team:
1) We can accept sanitized log extracts but not raw full audit streams.
2) If there are any onshore caching or proxy layers to avoid cross-border egress for short-term KV/cache hits, we need that documented and scoped.

Can you outline what you can deliver (files/links) and a realistic delivery timeline? If there's a gap that requires an addendum (UK IDTA or bespoke TIA clause), call that out.

Attached is Medigen's questionnaire excerpt so you can map asks to evidence items (we'll attach separately after this thread).

Thanks,
Oliver
Procurement Manager | Medigen Therapeutics
oliver.grant@medigen.com
+44 20 7000 9000
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medigen.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <privacy@medigen.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Initial ask: evidence provenance + subprocessor chain for EU/UK processing

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. High level response and proposed next steps below. I attached a compact evidence checklist and our current subprocessor manifest to get the conversation moving.

What we can deliver (short):
- Subprocessor manifest (attached CSV): company, function, region, contact, SOC/ISO attestations where available.
- Evidence typology (attached PDF): what we can provide per processor: SOC2 summary, subprocessor attestation, sanitized audit extracts (time-windowed), and ingress/egress scoping statements.
- TIA/DTIA scoping note: we map the evidence to common TIA asks; for customers requiring raw audit streams we handle on a case-by-case basis (usually via escrow or supervised review).
- UK IDTA / addendum path: we have a standard UK Addendum + signing flow (DocuSign) and corresponding checklist for evidence handoff.

What I recommend (actionable):
1) We provide the attached subprocessor_manifest_20280521.csv and tia-evidence-checklist.pdf by end of day today.
2) Align on acceptance of sanitized extracts vs raw logs. If Medigen signs off on sanitized extracts, we can complete the pack in ~5 business days.
3) If Medigen insists on raw audit log access, we scope an escrow or supervised audit (this will extend timeline by 2–3 weeks and require legal review).
4) I'll open a DocuSign for the UK Addendum (if you confirm you want to proceed).

Operational notes:
- Onshore caching: we support regionally pinned cache layers for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted customers we offer onshore proxy rules to minimize cross-border KV egress. We'll include an architecture snippet in the pack.
- Attachments and larger evidence will be delivered via a secure SharePoint/SFTP link; no raw logs will be uploaded unless agreed.

Next step: can you confirm (a) whether Medigen accepts sanitized extracts and (b) if you want the UK Addendum now or after evidence review? Once you confirm, I'll copy Legal/Security to finalize language.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: tia-evidence-checklist.pdf, subprocessor_manifest_20280521.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medigen.com>, Priya Shah <privacy@medigen.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence provenance and processor chain: onboarding constraints for Medigen

On Wed, May 21, 2028 at 12:05 PM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> What I recommend (actionable):
> 1) We provide the attached subprocessor_manifest_20280521.csv and tia-evidence-checklist.pdf by end of day today.

Quick internal notes from Security/Legal POV:
- We can provide attestation packages and SOC summaries per subprocessor.
- Raw audit logs: we generally do not export full raw streams for Hosted customers. Option: provide sanitized extracts (time-windowed + redacted PII) and a signed attestation confirming retention/chain-of-custody.
- Escrow/supervised audit: requires Legal OK, and we will need an NDA + scoped procedures. Recommend this only for very high-risk customers.
- Onshore cache / proxy: engineering can enable a regional cache pin for Dedicated customers; Hosted customers can use routing policies to reduce cross-border token hops but not guarantee zero egress.

Ask: Hannah — if Medigen needs onshore caching guarantees, we should surface Dedicated / Private deployment pricing early in negotiations.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security & Trust Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medigen.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <privacy@medigen.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence provenance and processor chain: onboarding constraints for Medigen

Hannah / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear options.

We confirm that Medigen is comfortable accepting sanitized audit extracts and attestation summaries for the initial onboarding. Please proceed with the 5-business-day pack.

We'd also like the UK Addendum in parallel — please send the DocuSign link and we'll route to our legal for signature. If the DocuSign can also include the TIA acceptance clause (checkbox for sanitized vs raw logs + escrow option), that would help speed approvals.

Delivery preferences: secure SharePoint link for the evidence pack, HubSpot updated with the pack delivery event (see link), and a follow-up call next Thursday to review the artifacts.

Thanks,
Oliver
Procurement Manager | Medigen Therapeutics
